nuggets.text: The Broncos' blue turf, installed in 1986, was the first non-green playing surface in football history.
The Broncos added new blue turf and a $70 million North End Zone at Albertsons Stadium for their first Pac-12 season.
The Broncos led No. 2 Oregon 17-14 at halftime of their opener before falling 34-27 in Eugene.
Spencer Danielson is 14-1 as head coach at Albertsons Stadium.
Spencer Danielson became the Broncos' interim coach in November 2023 and has since won three straight Mountain West titles.
Spencer Danielson played linebacker at San Diego and Azusa Pacific, then started coaching as a graduate assistant.
Ashton Jeanty scored all four Broncos touchdowns, two rushing and two receiving, in the 2023 game against Memphis.
Ian Johnson won the 2007 Fiesta Bowl for the Broncos on a Statue of Liberty two-point play, then proposed on live TV.
Boise State holds a U.S. trademark on non-green athletic fields, first registered for its blue field in 2009.
ESPN's Chris Berman once dubbed the Broncos' blue field 'The Blue Plastic Tundra.'
